text:
sasha: FYI support ticket: connector returned model-approved output but our schema gate rejected it -> routed to fallback and customer was billed.

ben: Any sample payload?

sasha: redacted: `{\"cmd\":\"create\",\"body\":\[\"acct-55\",\"Payment issue\"]}` - body is array; schema expects object `{account_id, summary}`.

kia: Router enforces schema before routing; mismatch causes degen path.

ops-bot: :warning: schema_mismatch spike on cluster-east-1 (4m)

sasha: Two asks: 1) make reject reason visible in traces + Console (redacted hint), 2) explore a conservative adapter coercion that maps positional arrays to objects when mapping rules are explicit.

ben: Implementation notes: add span tag `validator.reason` and metric `validation.mismatch_total{route,model}`. Introduce header `x-validate-mode: observe|suggest|enforce`. Default for rollout = observe (1%).

kia: Coercion MUST be reversible and off by default. For example positional->named mapping allowed only if connector declares positional schema: `{args_mapping: [\"project_id\",\"summary\"]}`. Coercion should attach `coercion.diff` to span (redacted).

lou: Console UX: show short hint "schema mismatch: body expected object, got array" behind org toggle default OFF. Never surface raw payload without explicit consent. For consented orgs show redacted diff and a button to request billing review.

sasha: Action items: ben to add span + metric, kia to prototype adapter coercion with reversible diffs, lou to mock Console toggle + billing review button. Sync in 40m.
